page.title: Appendix: the emphasis the source set and the site lost
page.standfirst_html:
The checker reports 11 lost runs on appendix-main, plus 13 added and 1 swapped. Each was checked against the source page image. Decisions were delegated by Lee on 2026-09-25, so this record is evidence rather than a review request.

After the pass: 10 lost · 0 added · 1 swapped, and every remaining run is cleared below.
